implementation_summary: review-model.ts: pure helpers. ReviewDraft holds unsaved changes. Setters cover finding fields, finding reset, Section text and reset, page remove/restore (a change back to the saved state is dropped), and redesign/repair choice and reset. draftToPatch builds the AuditEditsPatch (findings, sections with reset: true, removePages/restorePages, recommendations) and leaves out empty lists. findingRows, sectionRows, hierarchyTree and recommendationRows merge AuditGetReply.result, the saved EditOverlay and the draft for display, with originals kept. review-api.ts: loadAudit, loadEdits, loadPageContent and saveEdits call AUDIT_API get/getEdits/content/patchEdits through auditPath, with version and path as query values; refusals and bad replies become plain sentences. ReviewDocumentsScreen.tsx: ReviewDocumentsView is presentational. It shows the hierarchy with Remove/Restore and Edit Sections, a Sections editor (labelled textarea, original beside, reset), findings with labelled title/detail/suggestion fields (originals beside, reset), and a redesign-or-repair radio fieldset per Sample Page (proposed choice and reason, reset), plus Save and Discard and loading, error and no-result states. ReviewDocumentsScreen is the container: it loads the audit, loads Page Content on demand, saves, and reloads the stored edits when a save fails. Imports only react, ../../../components/text, ../results/analysis-text and '@qa/types/src/browser.js'.

tests_proposed: Interaction test with a DOM environment (typing, clicking Save) once the project adds jsdom or happy-dom; the current suite uses renderToStaticMarkup plus pure-model tests, matching the existing audit tests
wizard-e2e browser test of the review screen after FE-191 registers it in the router
evidence: AC-1 finding edit: tests 'sends a patch with only the changed text of that finding' and 'shows the edited text with the original beside it'
AC-2 page removal: test 'lists the page in removePages and shows it as removed with a restore control'
AC-3 Section edit/reset: test 'sends the urlPath, sectionId and new text; reset sends reset: true'
AC-4 markup: tests 'gives every input and textarea a label', 'gives every button an accessible name', 'uses no Avoid word in UI text'
AC-5 imports: test 'reaches @qa/types through browser.js only, and imports no Node-only module and no @qa/core'
risks: Packet named '@qa/types/src/website-audit.js'; the project T-211 rule requires '@qa/types/src/browser.js', which is what is used
The screen relies on the PATCH reply carrying every saved edit of the version (AuditEditsReply); a runner that returns only part of them would show stale state
No DOM test environment in the repo, so event handlers are covered through the pure model, not simulated clicks
The wizard tsconfig covers only src, so the test file is not type-checked
